name: Monal
subtitle: Monal for XMPP (iOS and macOS)
description: Single-app source for Monal (G7YU7X7KRJ.SworIM). Converted from altmaker.json.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Added DNSSEC bug warning.
• Fixed spurious MUC join errors.
• Fixed playback of received mp3 files.

• Fixed sharing location from Google Maps.
• Switched from iOS bundled libxml2 to new rust based xml parser to fix crashes.
• Now only accepting Channel/Group invites from contacts approved to our contact list.
• Fixed deeply nested xml DoS vector in push notification handler.
• Fixed several crashes.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Monal allows users to take photos and upload to a conversation
privacy.NSLocationUsageDescription: Monal uses your location when you send a location message in a conversation.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Monal uses your location when you send a location message in a conversation.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Monal uses the microphone to transmit your voice in audio messages or calls.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Monal allows users to save photos received in conversations.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Monal allows users to upload photos to recipients in a conversation
